db_layer.method: each payload executed directly as nl2sql_reader (validator bypassed); pass A in BEGIN READ ONLY, pass B in BEGIN READ WRITE; statement_timeout 2s; always ROLLBACK; fresh connection per pass. Only SQLSTATE 42501 (role), 25006 (read-only txn) and 57014 (timeout) count as a DB defence; undefined function/table/syntax errors are 'broken_payload' and count as inconclusive, never as a catch.
